title: Late Binding
description: multiply_all(n, x) builds n functions ("times 0", "times 1", ..., "times n-1") and applies each one to x. Every function seems to multiply by the same number.
hint: When does a lambda look up the value of `i`: when it's created, or when it's called?
explanation: Closures capture variables, not values. Each lambda looks up `i` when it is called, after the loop has finished, so they all see the last value. Bind the current value at creation time with a default argument (`i=i`) or `functools.partial`.
